description: Figure 12 illustrates the relationship between generation temperature and Pass@8 accuracy on merge sets from AIME 2024 and AMC datasets. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Pass@8 Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are three lines displayed: a blue solid line representing LUFFY, a red dashed line representing LUFFY w/SFT Loss, and a black solid line representing LUFFY Reasoning Traces. The LUFFY line begins at approximately 0.08 at a temperature of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.52 at a temperature of 1.0. The LUFFY w/SFT Loss line starts at approximately 0.12 at a temperature of 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.58 at a temperature of 1.0. Finally, the LUFFY Reasoning Traces line begins at approximately 0.06 at a temperature of 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.48 at a temperature of 1.0.
